rules.notes: A 1997 table layout with no classes or ids anywhere, so Readability has nothing to score and settles on the outer table, which brings the navigation strip (bel-7.gif, an image map) and the PAUL GRAHAM banner into the article above the text. The essay always sits alone in td[width="435"] and the navigation is a sibling cell of its ancestor, so naming the cell drops both. A few essays match two or three times; the extras are the one-line "Russian Translation" cells that follow the essay, and they come out at the end where they belong.
